relationships.subject: Femto-LASIK
relationships.evidence_quote: the CGRP level 5 days post-OP (271.51 ± 344.73 pg/mL) was significantly downregulated in comparison to pre-OP (735.39 ± 568.60 pg/mL; p < 0.029)

key_findings: Tear CGRP fell 5 days after Femto-LASIK and recovered by 90 days, while MMP-9, IL-1beta, IL-8 and NGF were unchanged.
Post-LASIK symptoms resemble discomfort rather than classical dry eye.
